feature_filter: Retain original columns with at least two presences across the fixed 138-row inventory; singleton each_other excluded; raw matrix unchanged.
family_definition: Personal-pronoun paradigm (singular/plural you and they pooled); compound determiner base (every/some/any/no). This addresses one grouping of dependence, not independence of all remaining items.
idf: log(N/max(1, number of anchor presences)), estimated separately from the remaining anchors in each fold and held fixed for target randomization.
percentile: empirical midrank: (number strictly below plus one half number tied)/B, with absolute tolerance 1e-12; not a posterior category probability.
interpretation: Continuous comparison of both distances and their contrast; no binary boundary rule. Report all controls and specifications; do not tune comparator membership or thresholds to preserve an outcome.
coding_sensitivity: For every retained feature, delete the column; invert its 0/1 polarity globally; and flip its coded value separately for each reciprocal. Report these as mechanical sensitivity, not established coding errors.
resampling: 2000 comparator resamples at original numbers of families, with replacement; family draws retain all recorded forms. Recompute distances, report as descriptive composition sensitivity, not additional independent observations.
